subject: English expressions of known Genesis and Ezekiel commentary sources
selection: Two works already known to Catena: Severian’s six Creation homilies (first homily only in this translation) and the distinct Augustine unfinished literal Genesis commentary already present in the discovery index. Existing Aurea, Lapide and NPNF English holdings were not duplicated. Origen’s fourteen Ezekiel homilies were already a known discovery lead; the publisher’s noncommercial grant permits acquiring the complete printed English homily expression.

verified_fragment_rows.basis: Complete Sermon 1, sections 1–7 and concluding doxology, on Genesis 1:1–5. The text explicitly treats creation, darkness, the moving spirit, light, day and night; its retrospective closing marks completion of the first day. Read against the complete HTML source, including numbered divisions, source notes and final paragraph. Translation by Roger Pearse from Bareille’s French, not directly from Greek; source wording, including awkward phrases, is unchanged. The publisher’s notes remain in the controlling text artifact but are not attributed to Severian in this passage. Later creation verses and other biblical quotations are supporting illustrations, not a wider direct commentary extent.

limitations: Severian: English from Bareille’s French intermediary; only homily 1 of 6.
Augustine: complete English source acquired, only sections 3.6–9.31 admitted in this bounded reading; the unfinished work is distinct from the twelve-book commentary.
No new translations composed. Rights and exact wording checks apply only to the identified expressions. Raw PDF/Word binaries remain remote exact-hash sources.

Origen: complete fourteen homilies acquired from 195 English publisher PDF pages under noncommercial permission; three complete sections page-verified and admitted. Other sections remain acquired but not passage-verified. Word-file extraction rejected after apparatus corruption; no corrupted Word derivative or passages retained. Original-language collation and composition dating remain unestablished.
